action_instruction: Waiting briefly while the available-slots view remains displayed
intent: PRIMARY: wait briefly while the Abhyasi available-slots view remains displayed
rationale: The open-sitting view visibly lists both requested linked-preceptor slots with available capacity.

action_instruction: Checking whether displayed available slots have remaining capacity
intent: whether every displayed slot visible to this Abhyasi with remaining capacity is present (in the Available slots list)

action_params.condition: Every displayed slot is visible to this Abhyasi with remaining capacity.
action_params.query: whether every displayed slot visible to this Abhyasi with remaining capacity is present (in the Available slots list)

action_instruction: Checking whether Prakash's eligible slot is displayed

action_params.query: whether the eligible slot {{global.linked_slot_a}} from one linked preceptor is present (under the Monday Oct 26 available slots)

action_instruction: Checking whether Priya's eligible slot is displayed

action_params.query: whether the eligible slot {{global.linked_slot_b}} from the other linked preceptor is present (under the Sunday Oct 25 available slots)
